itinerary.title: Reach Goa & Check In
itinerary.description: Pickup from Mapusa by 10:00 AM. Proceed to Vagator Beach. Check in at hotel. Freshen up. Evening visit to Baga Beach and enjoy the Boat Cruise. Dinner and overnight stay. 06 March 2025

itinerary.title: North Goa Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, proceed for North Goa sightseeing. Visit Calangute, Baga, and Anjuna beaches. Watch dolphins at Coco Beach. Dinner and overnight stay. 07 March 2025

itinerary.title: Old Goa & South Goa Sightseeing
itinerary.description: After breakfast, check out and proceed for South Goa sightseeing. Visit old Goa churches, Basilica of Bom Jesus, and Mangueshi Temple. Spend leisure time at Palolem Beach. Dinner and overnight stay. 08 March 2025
